An echo need not reflect from a mountain or cliff; remove the terrain restriction while preserving the example’s mountain echo.
The learner noun gerente names the managing person, not the managing institution included in the imported source gloss.
Importe is a monetary amount, not specifically the past sale price or market value of one item.
An ink stain need not be natural; remove the unsupported naturelle restriction.
Ansiedad is anxiety, not merely impatience or irritation; repair the narrowed French and Japanese definitions.
Desafío includes an organised sporting challenge and does not necessarily mean picking a quarrel.
Herencia in conserva una herencia is the inherited cultural content, not only the act of accepting and continuing it.
Repair the malformed French clause objecter à quelque chose sa véracité, which fails to express denial.
Reporte includes the account/document that contains results, not just the activity of informing.
Similarity does not imply being deficient or insufficient; remove that mistranslation of the contrast with perfect identity.
Solucionar requires resolution, not merely investigating or identifying a problem; it does not require deep investigation in every case.
Repair un large champs and express the intended adverbial scope.
Aporte is the contribution, not the bare state of being helpful.
Fix the inherited spelling vérouiller to verrouiller.
Cobrar el pedido is collecting payment; generic collection of any object does not define this selected Spanish sense.
Comedia is not restricted to plays or soap operas; films and other comic works are included.
Fever is raised body temperature, not merely feeling hot or an internal hot vapour.
Critical Japanese typo: 目 (eyes) must be 口 (mouth) for breathing.
Restore passive loss: 빼앗김 means being deprived, not taking something away from others.
Transferencia here moves materials to another location; it is not restricted to another person or time period.
Patience is a character quality, not an accumulated achievement or merit earned through good deeds.
Costado of a building is its side, not necessarily a corner (片隅).
Cómodo describes the armchair that provides comfort, not a person’s body being in good condition.
A fantasía need not be literally impossible; living in a castle is possible although fanciful for the character.
Repair malformed ni trop (au) chaud / ni trop (au) froid and express pleasantly cool.
Imponer a fine is imposing the obligation; it does not assert that collection has already occurred.
Restore catching as well as overtaking; the source Japanese omits the catch purpose of a chase.
Repair missing French contraction in afin quelle.
Precioso describes the valued memory or object, not the owner’s unwillingness to give it away.
The source replaces explanation with prétexte (excuse); restore the intended addition of explanation.
Avoid the source’s ambiguous from your computer wording, which can imply uploading; define receiving downloaded data.
The doctor explains the diagnostic conclusion, not only the act of examining the patient.
The selected sound-recording sense is not restricted to tapes or CDs; preserve digital recordings too.
Replace the malformed fruit-bearing kernels description and inconsistent tassel/fruit anatomy with the clear edible-cereal sense used in the salad example.
A wave is not a water current; source courant d’eau describes a different phenomenon.
A presa need not generate electricity; the example is an irrigation dam.
French reverses causation to having feelings toward someone; provocar causes the other person’s feeling.
Restore missing pas in the French non-biological-child clause.
Apartado modifies a location here, not a person left alone; source Japanese/Chinese and Korean impose a human subject.
Desempleo is the continuing unemployment state, not only the event of losing a job.
An emotional response is expressive or emotion-driven; it is not a person simply having many different emotions.
A combined naval fleet need not be a navy of allied countries; marine alliée adds that unsupported condition.
Repair French gender agreement courtes intervalles to courts intervalles.
Fruta is not restricted to fruit growing on woody trees; common fruits such as strawberries also qualify.
Repair agreement Aliments ... faite and retain the frozen-dessert sense.
Remove the false Christianity-or-Catholicism split and the French restriction to only Protestants or Catholics while preserving the religious-song sense.
Negotiation aims at agreement but does not necessarily result in a compromise; source French incorrectly guarantees the outcome.
A recibo acknowledges receipt and may be electronic; it need not be a piece of paper recording a generic transaction.
Sagrado need not be physically unapproachable or inherently pure and great; the example concerns a community’s religious regard.
Having expectations met is not having no further expectations; simplify malformed French wording and remove embedded format characters.
Surprising does not mean merely a little different from what was expected; remove the unsupported low degree.
Repair the duplicated malformed source wording the use or use of something useful.
The garden is the attraction/appealing feature, not only an abstract power to attract.
Japanese 肌着 wrongly makes an ordinary shirt underwear; repair French telle quelle agreement and clarify standalone wear.
Means of production is 生产资料, not 生产方式 (mode of production).
Use the idiomatic collocation commit a crime instead of do a crime.
Tremendo in effort denotes magnitude, not necessarily badness or excess; repair evaluative distortions in French/Japanese.
Vela is specifically a candle, not any object that gives light when ignited.
Alimento is not limited to a prepared dish eaten at a regular meal; the inherited rice/soup framing is too narrow.
Repair French verb étude to étudie.
A catalogue may be digital or another format; it need not be a small book-shaped advertisement.
The adjective evaluates leaving the keys in the car; it does not diagnose a person as incapable of making any sound judgement.
A garment label may be fabric or another material; do not restrict etiqueta to paper or wood.
Fuertemente is an ordinary manner adverb, not an ideophone, and does not itself mean suddenly. De pronto supplies suddenness separately.
Repair final Japanese comma into sentence-ending punctuation.
Support is encouraging/helping, not necessarily congratulating (féliciter).
A healthy appearance does not necessarily imply inner peace or a calm mental state.
The serve is not generally throwing the ball; preserve the act and its resulting ball rather than an incorrect throwing requirement.
University grounds are not necessarily a schoolyard or children’s cour de récréation; use the campus estate sense.
Replace the unnatural literal emprunter la force with hiring a person’s labour or services.
Remove ungrammatical de before quelque chose after prendre en compte.
A diagram is not necessarily a picture album or atlas (图册).
An oven need not have heat sources on every upper, lower and side surface; remove that construction restriction.
Bees collect nectar and produce honey from it; they do not collect ready-made honey directly from flowers.
Replace the unnatural literal si l’on examine la raison with the intended of-course discourse meaning.
Raison de la vie suggests the purpose of life; source refers to understanding how life works and judging rightly.
